proposed_sites.reason: The mcp.server.fastmcp module tree no longer exists in v2 with no compatibility alias; must become 'from mcp.server.mcpserver import MCPServer'.
Constructs FastMCP(...) directly; the identifier FastMCP no longer exists under any name in v2, so even after fixing the import this line's own text must change to MCPServer(...).
